dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the next free slot. It only confirms when there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) you still have to confirm.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items appear on the “Add order” screen.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Shows one category at a time. Tap a category to change it. Best for longer menus, where every item stays in the same place.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: Shows all items in one scrolling list, with a heading for each category. There are no category buttons — you move around by scrolling. Best for shorter menus, where you see most of it at once.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you can send it now and take payment later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into “Cash” and “Card”.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Shows a “Mark as ready” button on the order screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set up separately. Customers get an e-mail every time an order is marked as ready.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to add a pager
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the pager grid as soon as you send an order, so the number goes on the board while the customer is still in front of you. When it is off you can still add a pager any time by tapping the order, but nothing will remind you. Useful where you hand out pagers, and easy to switch off where you don’t.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: Turn this off during a card problem and customers will order as usual and pay at the counter instead. Orders keep coming; only the card payment step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This applies to your whole food truck, on all events, and stays off until you turn it back on.
